subject: StellarNet hosted pricing: token volumes & peak TPS
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@stellarnet.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 09:14:00 -0500
Subject: StellarNet hosted pricing follow-up + usage sketch

Thanks again for the demo earlier — good overview. I promised to send a short sketch of our expected usage so you can help model pricing and unit economics. High level:

- Primary workload: customer support summarization + short chat replies.
- Typical request size: ~350 tokens in, 300 tokens out (avg).
- Sessions per month (estimate): 1.2M user sessions, roughly 250–300K concurrent active sessions at peak across our fleet.
- Aggregate monthly token estimate: roughly 300M tokens/month (this is coarse; range: 200M–450M).
- Peak TPS: rough measured peak ~18–22 TPS over a 5–10 minute window during daily US morning.

We’re working against a target P&L: procurement is pushing for a target unit cost so our product economics work. Our internal target is around $2,000 per 1M tokens (negotiable with committed volume / SLA). Can you confirm what your hosted tiers look like at that band, and whether Redwood can meet 18–22 TPS with consistent latency SLAs?

I attached a one-sheet usage sample (SNL_usage_sample.csv) showing hourly session spread if that helps.

Next steps from our side: procurement wants an initial pricing band and any requirements for guaranteed burst capacity or warm pools. Can Marissa or Karthik propose a short checklist for what you need to turn this into a term sheet?

Thanks — Alicia
Alicia Gomez
Head of Product & Ops, StellarNet
A: +1 415 555 0198


From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@stellarnet.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: StellarNet hosted pricing follow-up + usage sketch

Alicia — thanks for the detail and the CSV, that’s very helpful. Quick clarifying questions up front:

- The 300M tokens/month is the central estimate but you gave a range to 450M — would you expect the extra tokens to be organic growth, or tied to specific campaigns (i.e., predictable spikes we should model differently)?
- When you say 250–300K concurrent active sessions at peak, is that user sessions or backend parallel inference calls? In Redwood terms we expect to size by peak TPS (total token/sec) but understanding concurrency helps with cache expectations.
- Do you need PII filtering / private deployment for any subset of traffic, or is all traffic OK to route through our hosted tier?

What I can share now from the hosted side:
- We can architect for sustained peaks in the low 20s TPS with our reserved instance pools + burst capacity if you commit to a target monthly slab.
- For a committed monthly volume in the 200–400M bucket we typically propose a blended band; indicative list pricing is $3,200 per 1M tokens at low commitment, sliding to $1,800–$2,400 per 1M with higher committed spend and contract term.
- We provide traffic shaping, automatic KV caching for repeated prefixes, and a warm pool option (small additional fee) to keep cold-start tail latency under control.

If $2,000 / 1M tokens is the internal target, we can model two options:
1) 12-month commitment at 300M/mo target → pricing target near $1,900 / 1M with burst pools and standard SLA.
2) 6-month pilot (200M/mo expected) with optional extension → higher per-1M (around $2,800) but faster onboarding and lower term commitment.

Attachments I’ll send next: a short pricing teaser and a checklist of procurement items (SLA, billing PO flow, security questionnaire items we’ll need answers to). Proposed next step: 30-min call this week to walk the procurement checklist and confirm the committed slab. Does Thu 03/31 10am PT work?

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@stellarnet.ai>

Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 13:38:00 -0400
Subject: Re: StellarNet hosted pricing follow-up + usage sketch

Thanks Karthik — answers inline below.

> would the extra tokens be organic growth or campaign-driven?
Mostly organic user growth as we ramp this feature across EU and APAC later this year. We might see campaign-driven spikes but those are short lived (couple days).

> concurrency vs backend parallel inference calls?
The 250–300K number was on the user sessions side; our instrumentation suggests peak inference parallelism is ~20–24 parallel calls (each call being one request/response) — so TPS aligns to ~20 if we account serialization/latency.

> any PII/private-deploy subset?
Small subset (~5% of sessions) requires regional data residency (EU) and could move to a private deployment later. For the hosted RFP, assume 95% of traffic is OK through hosted.

Confirmed monthly volume: central estimate 300M tokens/mo, acceptable range 200–450M. Peak TPS: plan for 22 TPS headroom.
Target unit economics: procurement wants to see pricing near $2,000 / 1M tokens for a multi-quarter commitment. If you can show a 12-month model at ~$1,900 with SLA and burst pools, procurement will be very interested.

We can do Thu 03/31 10am PT for the call — please send calendar invite and any prep materials you want procurement to review.

—Alicia
Alicia Gomez
Head of Product & Ops, StellarNet
